children: announced on Wednesday that it is now pushing Acrobat further beyond a traditional PDF reader into a broader document productivity platform with
The company said the new Acrobat capabilities include interactive reports and summary slides, along with personal podcasts, audio summaries, and Read Aloud tools.
These features are aimed at helping users quickly absorb information from individual documents or multiple files.
For businesses, Adobe introduced Knowledge Base and Analyzer to help teams search across documents and extract structured insights from thousands of files.
It also introduced Stylize, which can turn basic documents into polished reports, resumes, and presentations.
The company said Acrobat now handles more than 400B PDFs annually, while Student Spaces is as well now available globally after reaching more than 1M monthly active users during beta.

“Acrobat is already where millions of people come to read their most important information, and now it’s where people can understand it faster and more comprehensively,” said Abhigyan Modi, SVP, Productivity Product Group, at Adobe.
The company is also extending Acrobat capabilities to platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, WhatsApp, Edge, and Chrome.
The company said the new AI features are available across various Acrobat plans, while Knowledge Base and Analyzer are available for enterprise customers through Acrobat Studio.
Adobe plans to introduce new Acrobat Studio and Acrobat Express student packages, bringing professional document creation and collaboration tools to students.

title: What’s new at Adobe? Acrobat gets a major AI upgrade
